related.title: Venus Express 金星大氣探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有入射角、地形遮罩與投影方向齊備的像元才納入平地解析度比較。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Include pixels in the flat-ground comparison only when incidence, terrain mask and projection direction are known. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 以可追溯的兩時刻雲圖估計表觀雲移速率，辨認配準誤差。
related.differenceEn: Estimate apparent cloud drift from two traceable images and distinguish registration error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。斜距解析度 75 m，相對局部法線的入射角 30°，雷達視向朝右；只比較局部平面。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：δg=δr/sin θ=75/sin 30°。 結果約 150 m。平地近似下地距解析度等於斜距解析度除以入射角正弦；不適用陡坡疊掩區。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成雲標記位移 240 km，影像相隔 40 min，忽略投影縮短。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：v=240000/(40×60)。 結果約 100 m/s。局部平面且高度固定時 v=位移/時間；影像特徵不一定是同一空氣團。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use 75 m slant-range resolution, incidence 30° from the local normal and right-looking geometry on a local plane. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: δg=δr/sin θ=75/sin 30°. Result ≈ 150 m. For locally flat terrain, ground-range resolution is slant-range resolution divided by the sine of incidence angle; the model fails in layover.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic cloud displacement is 240 km over 40 min, neglecting foreshortening. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: v=240000/(40×60). Result ≈ 100 m/s. For a local plane at fixed altitude, v=displacement/time; an image feature need not track the same air parcel.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MAVEN 火星大氣探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有入射角、地形遮罩與投影方向齊備的像元才納入平地解析度比較。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Include pixels in the flat-ground comparison only when incidence, terrain mask and projection direction are known. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 從兩高度密度估算局部尺度高度，辨認非靜力條件。
related.differenceEn: Estimate local scale height from densities at two altitudes and identify nonhydrostatic conditions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。斜距解析度 75 m，相對局部法線的入射角 30°，雷達視向朝右；只比較局部平面。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：δg=δr/sin θ=75/sin 30°。 結果約 150 m。平地近似下地距解析度等於斜距解析度除以入射角正弦；不適用陡坡疊掩區。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成高度差 40 km，低處密度 100、高處 20，密度單位相同。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：H=40/ln(100/20)。 結果約 24.8534 km。等溫靜力近似 n2/n1=exp(−Δh/H)；僅在溫度、成分及重力近似固定時成立。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use 75 m slant-range resolution, incidence 30° from the local normal and right-looking geometry on a local plane. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: δg=δr/sin θ=75/sin 30°. Result ≈ 150 m. For locally flat terrain, ground-range resolution is slant-range resolution divided by the sine of incidence angle; the model fails in layover.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic altitude difference is 40 km, with lower density 100 and upper density 20 in identical units. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: H=40/ln(100/20). Result ≈ 24.8534 km. The isothermal hydrostatic approximation n2/n1=exp(−Δh/H) requires approximately fixed temperature, composition and gravity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
